riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who make discipline instinctive. Every position protects the formation's safety, and those who withstand the training earn trust.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The intensity comes from being a critical part of an airborne mission. You might not sit in the pilot's seat, but weapons, payload release, and cabin safety depend on you. Disciplined people who tolerate hard training and want to work close to aviation can find substantial trust and responsibility in the military system.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「把纪律练进骨头里」的人——任务里的一岗一哨，都是整个编队的安全；你扛得住训练，就配得上被信任。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的硬核感在「空中任务的一环」：你不上驾驶座，但武器能不能打、载荷能不能放、机舱安不安全，都系在你身上。你喜欢纪律、不怕苦训、又想离天空近一点，会在军队体系里找到「被信任」的分量。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits outgoing, quick-handed people with good social judgment. A bar is both business and human connection; mixing drinks is the entry ticket, while understanding people retains guests.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The appeal of this career is people. An office worker arrives after overtime and orders the usual; a little conversation helps them leave visibly more relaxed. Bartenders remember not only recipes but the feeling behind the drink each person wants.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Social S + Artistic A

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「外向、手快、懂分寸」的人——吧台是生意也是人情，会调酒是入场券，会接人才能留得住客。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的魅力在「人」：一个加班后的白领，点一杯老样子，你多聊两句，他走的时候明显轻松了。调酒师记住的不只是配方，是每个人想喝的那杯酒背后的心情。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 社会型 S + 艺术型 A

breadcrumb.label: Health And Safety Engineers, Except Mining Safety Engineers And Inspectors

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who treat others' safety as their own concern. Every corrective action you drive can stop an accident one day. That quiet value is a safety engineer's deepest professional confidence.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The occupation's clearest result is the accident no one sees. When a factory completes a year without a major incident, others take it for granted, but you know how many hazards were eliminated in advance. Outsiders rarely understand that satisfaction.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Realistic R + Enterprising E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「把别人的安全当自己的事」的人——你推动的每一条整改，都可能在某个时刻挡住一起事故。这种默默的价值感，是安全工程师最深的职业底气。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最实在的是「你看不见的事故，就是你的业绩」：一个工厂一年没出大事，大家觉得理所当然，但你知道背后有多少条隐患被提前掐掉。这种「不出事」的成就感，外人很难体会。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 现实型 R + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about hoist and winch operations and accept judgment under relatively low risk, this occupation is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field especially develops steadiness. Operators need tactile control and absolute discipline in following signals. It suits calm, focused, patient people.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on work, follows procedures, and coordinates operations (Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Hoist And Winch Operators有持续好奇、又不排斥低风险下的判断，操作员值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「稳字当头」——既要手感，也要绝对听信号。适合冷静、专注、不急躁的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手操作、重规程、也讲调度（现实 R + 常规 C + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you are continually curious about Instructional Coordinators and are not averse to making risky judgments, Instructional Coordinators are worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most important thing in this industry is "turning direction into action" - you need to know how to teach, and you also need to be able to push people to the ground. Suitable for people who are organized, good at communicating, and willing to work behind the scenes.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers teaching, relationship building, and orderly processes (Social S + Enterprising E + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Instructional Coordinators有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，教学协调员值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「把方向变成动作」——既要懂教学，也要会推人落地。适合有条理、善沟通、愿做幕后的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好教导与人脉经营、也重秩序（社会 S + 企业 E + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career fits people who combine rigor, rational judgment, and patience. Statutes must be cited accurately and explained clearly, while facts and logic must be organized in persuasive writing.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops close reading and disciplined attention to language. It suits people who are precise, patient with case files, and willing to take responsibility for conclusions from initial review through final draft.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers structured, investigative, and service-oriented work (Conventional C + Investigative I + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「严谨 + 理性 + 能坐冷板凳」凑一块的人——法条要引对也要说通，事实和逻辑要算清也要会写。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「字里行间的较真」——既要懂法条和逻辑算得清，也要有在卷宗里抠出关键事实的耐心。适合严谨、坐得住、又愿意对结论负责的人，也享受从阅卷到定稿的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好规矩、钻研、也助人（常规 C + 研究 I + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine skill and conversation. During two hours together, clients place both their hands and trust in you.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field combines craft, service, and aesthetics. Clients arrive with expectations and leave with satisfying hands. People who enjoy interaction and creating beautiful work by hand find achievement and client trust here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Artistic A + Enterprising E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「手艺好又爱聊天」的人——两小时的相处，顾客把手交给你，也把信任交给你。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行是「手艺+服务+审美」三合一：顾客带着期待来，带着满意的手走。喜欢和人打交道、又享受亲手做出好看东西的人，会在这里找到成就感和回头客的信任。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 艺术型 A + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who are hands-on, resilient, and careful. When the equipment you install passes its first test run, that is the best acceptance result.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this work lies in making equipment run. When machinery you installed passes its first test run and the workshop fills with the sound of normal operation, that is the best acceptance result. People who enjoy hands-on work, understand drawings, and do not mind dirt or hard labor find a tangible sense of being the backbone of industry.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「动手、吃苦、又心细」的人——你装的那台设备试车一次通过，就是最好的验收。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「转起来」：你安装的设备试车一次通过，车间里响起正常运转的声音，那就是最好的验收。喜欢动手、看得懂图纸、又不嫌活脏活累的人，会在这里找到「工业脊梁」的实在感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine attention to detail + organization + kindness. Eyewear must be accurate and comfortable, requiring a balance of parameters and face shape as well as adjustment skill.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops precision in your hands and accuracy in your eyes. You must understand optics and prescriptions while also sensing how to adjust a frame to fit a face. It suits careful people who can stay focused, take responsibility for others, and enjoy the full process from refraction to delivery.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers helping others, practical work, and routine (Social S + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细心 + 有条理 + 对人好」凑一块的人——眼镜要做得准也要戴得舒服，参数和脸型要平衡也要会调。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手上的细与眼里的准」——既要懂光学与处方，也要有把镜架调到贴合的脸感。适合细心、坐得住、又愿意对人负责的人，也享受从验光到交付的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、务实与重常规（社会 S + 务实 R + 常规 C）。

breadcrumb.label: Rail Yard Engineers, Dinkey Operators, And Hostlers

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you enjoy tangible work, finishing a shift with trains departing on time and no incidents offers more genuine satisfaction than any report.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The work environment is direct: there is little office politics, and quality is immediately visible. Railway systems are stable with standardized benefits, making this a classic secure job.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你喜欢「实打实的活儿」——干完一班，列车准点发出，安全无事故，这种朴素的成就感，比任何报表都实在。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的工作环境很「真实」：没有办公室政治的弯弯绕，活儿干得好不好一眼就能看出来。而且铁路系统稳定、福利规范，是典型的「铁饭碗」岗位。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine attention to detail, data intuition, and accountability for ROI. Keywords must be selected precisely and spending must create value, while data and creative work must be balanced.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field particularly develops the ability to find business opportunities in search intent. You must understand keyword and bidding logic while determining whether users want to buy or compare options. It suits careful, data-sensitive people willing to take responsibility for ROI.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: A preference for practical work, creativity, and helping others (Enterprising E + Artistic A + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细心 + 数据感 + 对 ROI 负责」凑一块的人——词要选得准也要花得值，数据和创意要平衡也要会看。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在搜索意图里找生意」——既要懂关键词和出价逻辑，也要能判断用户到底想买还是想比价。适合细心、对数据敏感、又愿意对 ROI 负责的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、创造也助人（企业 E + 艺术 A + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This occupation's greatest weight is knowing the equipment you maintain affects the safety of an entire line. When a train passes smoothly after you adjust a switch and eliminate a hazard, the overnight work feels worthwhile.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most reassuring aspect of this work is that responsibility creates meaning. Every bolt you tighten and every gap you adjust affects the safety of dozens of trains each hour. Watching trains pass smoothly over a switch you maintain creates a powerful sense of contributing to every journey.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最重的是「你维护的设备关系到整条线的安全」——调好一组道岔、排除一个隐患，列车平稳驶过的那一刻，你会觉得这份夜班熬得值。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最让人踏实的是「责任即意义」：你拧紧的一颗螺栓、调好的一组缺口，关系着每小时几十趟列车的安全。看着列车在自己维护的道岔上稳稳通过，那种「这趟车有我一份力」的感觉很重。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 研究型 I + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine compassion, patience, and communication skills. Children must be understood, parents engaged, and plans balanced with emotions.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops the ability to make complexity teachable. You need knowledge of development and behavior and the patience to teach one child repeatedly. It suits caring, emotionally steady people who are willing to communicate with both families and schools.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social and Artistic preferences (Social S + Artistic A).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「爱心 + 耐心 + 善沟通」凑一块的人——孩子要读懂，家长要连，计划和情绪要平衡。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「把复杂变可教」——既要懂发展和行为，也要有对一个孩子反复教的耐心。适合有爱心、能稳定情绪、又愿意和家校两头沟通的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、也创造（社会 S + 艺术 A）。

breadcrumb.label: Teaching Assistants, Preschool, Elementary, Middle, And Secondary School, Except Special Education

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine care for children, patience, and communication. Discipline must remain stable, foundational skills require support, and student growth needs attention.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops patience and differentiated communication. Assistants must manage classroom rhythms for different ages while gradually helping struggling students understand at their grade level. It suits patient people who care about children, can concentrate, and are willing to take responsibility for growth.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers helping others, creativity, and initiative (Social S + Artistic A + Enterprising E).

breadcrumb.label: 教学助理（学前及中小学）

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把爱孩子、有耐心、善沟通凑一块的人——纪律要稳，基础要带，成长要盯。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练耐心加分层沟通——你既要hold住不同年纪的课堂节奏，也要把基础薄弱的学生按学段一点点带明白。适合爱孩子、坐得住、又愿意对成长负责的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、创造、也经营（社会 S + 艺术 A + 企业 E）。

breadcrumb.label: Textile Cutting Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits steady-handed, detail-oriented people who enjoy working through challenges with machines. Watching batches of your cut pieces become garments provides the practical reward of knowing no material was wasted and no work required rework.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The reassuring part of this field is that the craft stays with you. After cutting many fabrics, you know which materials resist the blade and which tend to shift. When factory orders become urgent, experienced operators provide the most reliable support.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

breadcrumb.label: 纺织机器铺设工、操作员、看护员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「手稳心细、能跟机器较劲」的人——看着自己切出来的裁片一批批变成成衣，那种「料没浪费、活儿没返工」的踏实感，是这行最真实的回报。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最踏实的是「手艺长在身上」：裁过的面料多了，什么布吃刀、什么布跑料，心里有数；厂里单子紧了，老操作工就是最稳的保障。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine organization, resilience, and coordination. Goods must move quickly and economically, while the chain must stay smooth and stable.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops system-wide thinking and the ability to keep the chain under control. You must understand transportation and warehousing end to end and make decisions during overloaded warehouses and delays. It suits organized, resilient people willing to take responsibility for fulfillment.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising, practical, and orderly (Enterprising E + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「条理 + 能扛压 + 会协调」凑一块的人——货要快也要省，链要顺也要稳。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「全局 + 压得住链」——既要懂运输仓储全链路，也要会在爆仓和延误时拍板。适合有条理、能扛压、也愿意为履约负责的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好带队、务实、也秩序（企业 E + 现实 R + 常规 C）。
